rev.t: Visited Vidhya Book House based on recommendations from friends for thesis certificate printouts. I complied with their instructions to remove my helmet and leave my bag outside without any objection. …

Excellent bookstore with a wide range of academic books, notebooks, and all kinds of stationery items. Prices are reasonable, and they offer great discounts. Their printing services are affordable and very convenient for students around …
No fuss book store, well equipped and stacked. Felt like the owner should clean up and make it tidy otherwise one would find what he/she is looking for.
